correctness.rationale: The planar reduction is correct. Monotonicity of the boundary normal forces exactly two interior facets, with active shape interval \(c<r<b\). Direct line-intersection geometry gives the two facet lengths and hence the mass ratio \(\Phi_p(r)=r^{1-p}(r-c)/(c(b-r))\); for \(p\ne2\) the first mass fixes scale. Its logarithmic derivative reduces criticality to \(p-1=H(r)\), where \(H\) has unique minimum at \(r=\sqrt{bc}\), giving the displayed threshold and the exact one/two/three-root trichotomy. At \(p=2\) scale cancels and the two mass equations reduce to the stated compatibility curve. Fresh symbolic differentiation gave \(H'(r)\) proportional to \(r^2-bc\), confirming the critical geometry.
